points.title: 战争与流亡
points.description: 朴正熙在1940年代初期被日本占领韩国期间，被迫在日本接受教育。1945年日本投降后，他回到韩国，开始了他的政治生涯。在战争和流亡期间，他深受日本殖民统治的影响，这对他后来的政治理念产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: During the 1940s, Park Chung Hee was forced to study in Japan under Japanese occupation of Korea. After Japan's surrender in 1945, he returned to Korea and began his political career. His experiences under Japanese colonial rule deeply influenced his political philosophy.

points.title: 政治生涯初期
points.description: 朴正熙在韩国民主化进程中扮演了重要角色。他在1948年成为韩国陆军少校，并在1952年成为国防部次官。在这一时期，他参与了韩国的政治和军事事务，为后来的军事政变奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Park Chung Hee played a significant role in Korea's democratization process. He became a lieutenant colonel in the South Korean Army in 1948 and served as the Deputy Minister of National Defense in 1952. During this period, he was involved in South Korea's political and military affairs, laying the groundwork for his later military coup.

points.title: 军事独裁统治
points.description: 1961年，朴正熙发动军事政变，成为韩国总统。在他的统治下，韩国经历了快速的工业化和现代化。他实施了一系列经济改革，使韩国成为世界第11大经济体。然而，他的统治也以镇压政治反对派和限制言论自由而闻名。
points.descriptionEn: In 1961, Park Chung Hee led a military coup and became the President of South Korea. Under his rule, South Korea experienced rapid industrialization and modernization. He implemented a series of economic reforms that turned South Korea into the 11th largest economy in the world. However, his regime was also known for suppressing political opposition and restricting freedom of speech.

points.title: 遇刺身亡
points.description: 1979年10月26日，朴正熙在首尔被暗杀，结束了他的统治。他的死引发了韩国政治动荡，但他的遗产在韩国政治中仍然有着深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: On October 26, 1979, Park Chung Hee was assassinated in Seoul, ending his rule. His death led to political turmoil in South Korea, but his legacy continues to have a profound impact on Korean politics.

appraisal.zh: 史学界普遍视朴正熙为韩国现代化的关键推手，其经济改革使国家由贫弱走向强盛，工业化与国防建设亦在其任内奠定。不过，也有研究者指出，其统治带有明显的独裁色彩，压制政治反对、限制言论自由，并常以强力手段维系权力，经济政策同时加剧了社会不平等。正因功过如此悬殊，他的遗产在韩国政治中至今仍是复杂议题。
appraisal.en: Historians generally regard Park Chung Hee as the key driver of South Korea's modernization, whose economic reforms turned a poor nation into an economic powerhouse and whose tenure laid the groundwork for industrialization and national defense. Yet researchers also note that his rule was markedly dictatorial, suppressing political opposition, restricting free speech and often using force to hold power, while his economic policies deepened social inequality. Because achievement and abuse are so starkly uneven, his legacy remains a complex topic in Korean politics.

supporter.zh: 朴正熙被视为韩国现代化的关键人物，他的经济改革使韩国从贫穷落后转变为经济强国。他的贡献包括推动韩国的工业化和现代化，以及建立强大的国防。
supporter.en: Park Chung Hee is seen as a key figure in South Korea's modernization, with his economic reforms transforming the country from a poor and backward nation into an economic powerhouse. His contributions include promoting South Korea's industrialization and modernization, as well as establishing a strong national defense.

critic.zh: 朴正熙的独裁统治和镇压政治反对派的行为受到批评。他的政府限制言论自由，并经常使用暴力手段来维持权力。此外，他的经济政策也导致了一些社会不平等。
critic.en: Park Chung Hee's dictatorial rule and suppression of political opposition are criticized. His government restricted freedom of speech and often used violent means to maintain power. Moreover, his economic policies also led to some social inequalities.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，朴正熙被视为韩国现代化进程中的重要人物，但他的统治方式和政策也存在争议。他的遗产在韩国政治中仍然是一个复杂的话题。
objective.en: In historical academia, Park Chung Hee is seen as an important figure in South Korea's modernization process, but his governing style and policies are also controversial. His legacy remains a complex topic in Korean politics.

self.zh: ‘韩国的现代化不是一夜之间就能实现的，需要时间和努力。’
self.en: 'The modernization of Korea is not something that can be achieved overnight; it requires time and effort.'
